Tassattho– sādhu bhante Bhagavā aññaṁ kāraṇaṁ ācikkhatu, yena bhikkhusaṁgho arahatte patiṭṭhaheyya, mahāsamuddaṁ orohaṇatitthāni viya hi aññānipi dasānussati dasakasiṇa catudhātuvavatthāna brahmavihārānāpānassatippabhedāni bahūni nibbānorohaṇakammaṭṭhānāni santi, tesu Bhagavā bhikkhū samassāsetvā aññataraṁ kammaṭṭhānaṁ ācikkhatūti adhippāyo.
attano paresañca hitaṁ sādhetīti sādhu, sammā paṭipanno.

Bhagavā heṭṭhā na ca mayaṁ bhante piṇḍakena kilamimhāti vutte na sādhukaramadāsi.

Bhagavā kira ādito paṭṭhāya niddaṁ anokkamantova imaṁ suttaṁ sutvā Ānandena sekhapaṭipadāya kūṭaṁ gahitanti ñatvā uṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvā nisinno sādhukāraṁ adāsi, ettāvatā ca pana idaṁ suttaṁ Jinabhāsitaṁ nāma jātaṁ.
Dīghatapassissa sādhukāraṁ dento bhanteti Bhagavantaṁ ālapati.
Tassa Bhagavā mūlavasena saṁkhittadesanaṁ, kammapathavasena vitthāradesanaṁ desesi.
Hatthāḷavakacittagahapati-ādīnaṁ viya maggena āgatā patiṭṭhitasaddhā nāma sādhu.

sādhu.l: na taṁ jitaṁ sādhu jitaṁ, yaṁ jitaṁ avajīyatī
sādhu.g: yaṁ paccāmitte parājinitvā raṭṭhaṁ jitaṁ paṭiladdhaṁ punapi tehi1 paccāmittehi avajīyati, taṁ jitaṁ sādhujitaṁ nāma na hoti.

sādhu.l: Taṁ kho jitaṁ sādhu jitaṁ, yaṁ jitaṁ nāvajīyatī
sādhu.g: yaṁ kho pana paccāmitte nimmathetvā jitaṁ puna tehi nāvajīyati, yo vā ekavāraṁ laddho jayo na puna parājayo hoti, taṁ jitaṁ sādhu jitaṁ sobhanaṁ, so jayo sādhu sobhano nāma hoti.

dve ime dhammā yehi sabhāgadhammā sādhāraṇā nāma honti.
itaro pana samūho jigucchatīti kimeva vattabbaṁ.

Tassattho–yathā micchattaniyatānaṁ aniyatānañca sādhāraṇāti vuttaṁ, evaṁ sādhāraṇā dhammā na sabbasattānaṁ sādhāraṇatāya sādhāraṇā, kasmā? Yasmā aññamaññaṁ paraṁ paraṁ sakaṁ sakaṁ visayaṁ nātivattanti.

Sādhāraṇabhogī.g: ettha sādhāraṇabhogino idaṁ lakkhaṇaṁ–yaṁ yaṁ paṇītaṁ labhati, taṁ taṁ neva lābhena lābhaṁ nijigīsanamukhena gihīnaṁ deti attano ājīvasuddhiṁ rakkhamāno, na attanāva paribhuñjati “mayhaṁ asādhāraṇabhogitā mā hotū”ti.

imasmiṁ ṭhāne Pāḷi vuttā, imasmiṁ ṭhāne attho vutto, imasmiṁ ṭhāne anusandhi kathito, imasmiṁ ṭhāne pubbāparaṁ kathitanti suṭṭhu gahetvā.
sakkaccaṁ sīlāni samādiyantassāpi, na diguṇaṁ, tiguṇaṁ vā ussāho karaṇīyo.
sakkaccaṁ sīlāni samādiyantassāpi appaṭṭhatarameva appasamārambhatarañca, na diguṇaṁ ussāho karaṇīyoti vuttaṁ hoti.
yathāsutaṁ dhammaṁ vācuggatakaraṇavasena taṁ paguṇaṁ katvā sāravasena dhāreti.
“imasmiṁ ṭhāne Pāḷi vuttā, imasmiṁ ṭhāne attho vutto, imasmiṁ ṭhāne anusandhi kathitā, imasmiṁ ṭhāne pubbā paraṁ kathitan”ti suṭṭhu gahetvā.
paggaṇhantenāpi samādhissa vīriyasamatāyojanavasena paggahitattā sakkaccaṁ ajjhupekkhati, tatramajjhattupekkhā okāsaṁ labhati.
vīriyassa samaṁ hutvā pavattattā puna vīriyasamatāniyojane byāpāraṁ akaronto tatramajjhattupekkhāvasena sādhukaṁ ajjhupekkhati nāma.

Sādhāraṇaparibhogenā.g: attanā samānaparibhogena, sādhāraṇaparibhogena ca samasamaṭṭhapanena ca anuggahitoti sambandho.

Sādhāraṇaparibhogena.g: attanā samānaparibhogena, sādhāraṇaparibhogena ca samasamaṭṭhapanena ca anuggahitoti sambandho.

sādhāraṇaṁ.l: Lakkhaṇaṁ sattarasadhā, ṭhitaṁ sādhāraṇaṁ idaṁ, ñatvā

Sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇadhammavibhāgato.g: pahānekaṭṭhasahajekaṭṭha- tādisāmaññena ye dhammā yesaṁ dhammānaṁ nāmavatthādinā sādhāraṇā tabbidhuratāya asādhāraṇā ca, taṁvibhāgato duvidhanti attho.

Sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇadhammavibhāgata.g: pahānekaṭṭhasahajekaṭṭha- tādisāmaññena ye dhammā yesaṁ dhammānaṁ nāmavatthādinā sādhāraṇā tabbidhuratāya asādhāraṇā ca, taṁvibhāgato duvidhanti attho.

sādhāraṇāyā.g: dukkhāpaṭipadāya khippābhiññāya, sukhāpaṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya ca niyyātīti sambandho.

sādhāraṇāya.g: dukkhāpaṭipadāya khippābhiññāya, sukhāpaṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya ca niyyātīti sambandho.

Sādhāraṇāni.g: saṁkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, saṁkilesabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, saṁkilesabhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca, vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañcāti evaṁ padantarasaṁyojanavasena missitāni katāni.

sādhāraṇāni.l: Tāniyeva aṭṭha suttāni sādhāraṇāni katāni soḷasa bhavantī
sādhāraṇāni.g: tāniyeva yathāvuttāni aṭṭha suttāni vāsanābhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṁkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, nibbedhabhāgiyañca saṁkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṁkilesabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṁkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, nibbedhabhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca nevasaṁkilesabhāgiyañca, navāsanābhāgiyañca ninibbedhabhāgiyañca na-asekkhabhāgiyañcāti evaṁ sādhāraṇāni katāni purimāni aṭṭha imāni aṭṭhāti soḷasa bhavanti.

sādhu,.l: Na taṁ kammaṁ kataṁ sādhu, yaṁ katvā anutappatī
sādhu,.g: yaṁ kammaṁ nirayādīsu nibbattanasamatthaṁ dukkhudayaṁ katvā anussaritānussaritakkhaṇe anutappati anusocati, taṁ kataṁ na sādhu na sundaraṁ na bhaddakaṁ.

sādhāraṇo.g: pañhe phassādayo sandhāya paṭikkhipati, kammasamuṭṭhānaṁ rūpañca pathavī-ādīnaṁyeva ca sādhāraṇabhāvaṁ sandhāya paṭijānāti.
